fun_facts: At age 12, Aaron Jones Sr. moved to El Paso after seeing the movie *Glory Road*; the trip inspired his family to move there.
At one practice, Aaron Jones Sr. won a race that decided who would play running back.
In 2016, Aaron Jones Sr. ranked fourth nationally in rushing yards, with 1,773 for UTEP.

In one 2019 game, Aaron Jones Sr. caught seven passes for 159 yards and two touchdowns. He became the first Packers running back since the league merger to record a game with at least 150 receiving yards and two receiving touchdowns.
In a 2019 game against Dallas, Aaron Jones Sr. scored four rushing touchdowns, becoming the first player to rush for four in a game against the Cowboys.
